text: Hey Allie — can I ask you a favor? Things with Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and honestly I'd rather not see her outside of work for now. I'm not trying to make it a thing or push anyone to take sides, I just wanted you to know so you don't end up putting the two of us together somewhere. I know you're friends with both of us, and that's totally fine with me. Thank you for hearing me out.

Thanks for telling me, Jordan — that means something. I won't put you two in the same plan unless there's no way around it, and if something like that ever comes up I'll check with you first. And I'm not taking sides; I'm just glad you said it.
Thank you — that's all I needed. I really appreciate it.

Hey Allie! Random idea — you should have people over this Saturday, around 3:30? Your place is the best for that kind of thing. Maybe invite Jordan too, if you feel like it. No pressure, just thought it'd be nice.

That does sound nice — I'm in. Saturday 3:30 at my place.

I'll skip Jordan for this one; better if today isn't the day for that. I'll ask a couple of others instead. Bring whatever you feel like, I'll sort out the rest.
Great, Saturday 3:30 it is. Honestly if Jordan ends up invited after all, I'd be glad — but it's your call, and I'm happy either way. I'll bring something to eat.
Noted — and thanks. I'll leave it as it is for now. Bring food, I'll take care of drinks.
